checks.claim: New INSPIRE files are published on the first Sunday of every month.
INSPIRE download is organised by local authority.
INSPIRE represents indicative extent and position, not an exact legal boundary.
INSPIRE contains registered freehold property locations in England and Wales.
INSPIRE is a subset of the freehold Index Polygons database.
A polygon crossing a local-authority boundary can appear in both authority files.
HMLR GML data is captured against British National Grid.
HMLR identifies British National Grid as EPSG:27700 for reprojection workflows.
GML can be converted to formats such as ESRI Shapefile, GeoJSON, DXF and KML.
Reprojection from British National Grid to WGS84 can introduce positional error.
HMLR warns some reprojections may shift features by up to 15 metres.
